title: fix(studio): the Interfaces canvas shows a draft-only object as not published instead of asking /meta/object (objectui#12508)
body:
Fixes #12508
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Round 2 of objectui#12508. Round 1 (PR objectui#12560, `d17952c`) removed the `/layers` 404s and the `/ai/models` 501. The one 404 left in the card's session came from the Interfaces canvas: for an object that has only a draft, `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` mounted the runtime `object-view`, whose `ObjectView` asked `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` through `useSettledSchema`, got a 404, logged `getObjectSchema failed … MetadataNotFoundError` twice and showed "Error loading grid".

- **`InterfacesPillar`** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the canvas mount) hands the canvas the draft-only names it already derives from its package read, through a new Studio-internal context, `StudioCanvasDraftOnlyObjectsContext`, beside `StudioCanvasListViewContext`. The value is `known` (the names) only when the read ran under the current `publishNonce`; any other answer is `pending`. If that read fails, the effect now records an empty set under that publish, so the canvas renders the grid as before rather than wait.
- **`StudioObjectRecordsCanvas`** (`studio-canvas-preview.tsx`): for a name that is known draft-only it shows the Studio's empty-state pattern, "This object is not published yet" with "Publish the package to see its records here." While the answer is `pending` it shows the Studio loading line. Otherwise it renders the runtime grid exactly as before. A canvas outside the pillar sees no context and renders as it always did. `registerStudioCanvasPreview` overrides are untouched, and the published `StudioCanvasPreviewProps` face is unchanged (the context is not exported from the package entry).
- **i18n** (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`): two new keys, en and zh, `engine.studio.if.objectUnpublishedTitle` and `engine.studio.if.objectUnpublishedHint`. Existing keys and `data-testid`s are unchanged.

No server change, no new request, no spec read.

## Route and reason

Route 2 (the empty state) over route 3 (render the grid from the draft schema). Route 3 was measured, not assumed: for a draft-only object `GET /api/v1/data/st_ticket` answers 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, so a grid built from the draft would still ask for records and get an error.

- Real need: the measured session asks two reads the server correctly refuses; an author opening a just-created object sees an error panel. Route 3 trades one 404 for another.
- Long-term: preview = runtime (epic objectui#12446, decision D). A draft-only object has no runtime, and the canvas says so instead of inventing one. Route 3 needs a new `ObjectView` input outside this surface, and a records grid for a table that does not exist.
- AI-safety: the canvas reads one stamped answer one way (current publish = known, anything else = pending); there is no consumer-side default that would hide a stale or missing answer.
- Startup focus: no new endpoint, no new request, two i18n keys.

## Deviations

- A published object's canvas can show the loading line briefly while the pillar's package read for the current publish is in flight. Treating 'not known yet' as published would mount the grid for a draft-only object whenever the leaf load wins that race, which is the measured 404.
- One line outside the canvas mount: the package-objects effect's failure path records an empty set (see above). For the list-view panel an empty set reads exactly as the old null did.
- `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` gains one `react-refresh/only-export-components` lint warning on the new context export, the same warning its two sibling contexts carry.

## Test evidence (at `fa38479`)

New pin `InterfacesPillar.canvasDraftOnly-12508.test.tsx` (the real `InterfacesPillar` and default canvas; `object-view` is a registry recorder whose mount stands for `ObjectView`'s schema read): a draft-only object shows the empty state and mounts no `object-view`; CONTROL, a published object mounts it; after a publish with the pillar's re-read held, the canvas shows the pending state and never the empty state, then mounts the grid once the re-read answers. 3 passed.

Each behaviour was ablated once with `ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation verified on disk, red observed, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- The canvas's draft-only branch disabled: 3 red. The draft-only tests cannot find the empty state, and the CONTROL reads `expected [ 'st_ticket', 'st_case' ] to deeply equal [ 'st_case' ]`, because the pillar auto-opens the first entry (the draft-only one) and the CONTROL pins the exact mount list.
- The pillar's `publishNonce` stamp ignored: the publish test red (`Unable to find … studio-canvas-object-pending`), the other two green.

Runs (repo-root vitest spelling, through the shared verification lock):

- The canvas, `InterfacesPillar.*`, round-1 pins (`DataPillar.draftOnlyNoLayers-12508`, `ObjectListViewInspector.draftOnlyObject-12508`) and every test file naming `InterfacesPillar`, `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` or `studio-canvas-preview`: 47 files, 292 tests passed.
- The remaining `StudioDesignSurface.*` suites in two halves: 22 files / 100 tests and 21 files / 214 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (`tsconfig.test.json` lists the new pin). `build`: exit 0 (dist completeness verified).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched files: 0 errors; warnings equal to `main` except the one noted under Deviations.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: all exit 0.
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite was not run locally (foreground cap); CI runs it.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12508-canvas-draft-only-object.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- After a publish, the list-view panel asks `GET /meta/view/st_ticket.default/layers` once and reads its 404 as "not created yet". That is the path round 1 kept on purpose for a published object whose default list view was never created (the objectui#11799 pins); a publish is not part of the card's session.
